# WorkoutPlanMaker

Free browser-based adult workout templates and macro estimates. No account. Inputs stay in the current tab. Not medical advice.

- [Get Your Personalized Workout Plan](https://workoutplanmaker.com/): Build a free personalized workout plan, calorie estimate and daily macros from 8 questions. No signup. Your answers stay in your browser.
- [Macro Calculator](https://workoutplanmaker.com/macro-calculator.html): Calculate daily protein, fat and carbs for free. Enter a calorie target or estimate energy needs. All calculations stay in your browser.
- [Privacy Policy](https://workoutplanmaker.com/privacy-policy.html): How WorkoutPlanMaker processes fitness inputs locally, handles print files and uses Google Analytics for visits without sending body details.
- [TDEE Calculator](https://workoutplanmaker.com/tdee-calculator.html): Calculate TDEE and BMR free with Mifflin-St Jeor, Harris-Benedict and Katch-McArdle. No sign-up; your fitness inputs stay in your browser.
- [BMI Calculator](https://workoutplanmaker.com/bmi-calculator.html): Check your BMI free: enter height and weight to get your BMI, category and healthy weight range. No sign-up, instant result in your browser.
- [Calorie Deficit Calculator](https://workoutplanmaker.com/calorie-deficit-calculator.html): Plan your calorie deficit free: set your weight-loss goal and pace to get your daily calorie target and target date. No sign-up, instant result.
- [Workout Plan for Beginners Over 40](https://workoutplanmaker.com/workout-plan-for-beginners-over-40.html): A simple workout plan for beginners over 40: low-impact strength twice a week, daily walking, and rest days. No gym needed. Free, no sign-up.
- [How to Calculate Macros for Weight Loss](https://workoutplanmaker.com/how-to-calculate-macros.html): How to calculate macros for weight loss: find your TDEE, set your calorie target, then split protein, fat and carbs. Worked example inside.
- [Workout Plan for Women Over 50](https://workoutplanmaker.com/workout-plan-for-women-over-50.html): A workout plan for women over 50: strength twice a week, balance drills, and daily walking to protect bone and muscle. No gym needed.
- [Workout Plan for Busy Moms](https://workoutplanmaker.com/workout-plan-for-busy-moms.html): A workout plan for busy moms: 20-minute home workouts, no equipment, 3 days a week. Fit exercise around school runs and nap times.
- [Protein Calculator](https://workoutplanmaker.com/protein-calculator.html): Protein calculator: enter your weight and goal to see how much protein you need per day, in grams and per meal. Free, no sign-up.

- [1RM Calculator](https://workoutplanmaker.com/1rm-calculator.html): 1RM calculator: enter the weight you lifted and your reps to estimate your one-rep max with 7 formulas. Free, no sign-up.
- [Body Fat Calculator](https://workoutplanmaker.com/body-fat-calculator.html): Body fat calculator: enter your height and waist to estimate body fat with the U.S. Navy method. Free, no sign-up.
- [Free MyFitnessPal Alternative](https://workoutplanmaker.com/myfitnesspal-alternative.html): A free alternative to MyFitnessPal: calculate macros and build a 4-week plan in your browser. No account, no uploads — your numbers stay on your device.
- [Macro Calculator vs TDEE Calculator](https://workoutplanmaker.com/macro-calculator-vs-tdee-calculator.html): TDEE sets your calorie budget; macros split it into protein, fat and carbs. Use the TDEE calculator first, then the macro calculator.
- [Can You Trust a Free Calorie Calculator](https://workoutplanmaker.com/can-you-trust-a-free-calorie-calculator.html): Can you trust a free online calorie calculator? Check where your data goes, which formula it uses, and what it admits it cannot know.
